slides.texte_overlay:
things that quietly make
you more attractive

good posture

stand tall with your shoulders back and your chin level. posture is the first thing people read about you, long before your face or your clothes, and it costs nothing.

a calm voice

speak a little slower and lower than you normally would. a relaxed voice tells everyone you're comfortable in your own skin, and that ease is deeply attractive.

really listening

put your phone away and listen without planning your reply. being fully heard is so rare today that people feel quietly drawn to whoever gives them that gift.

a curious mind

spend 5 minutes a day learning one fascinating thing: a strange animal, a lost city, a famous painting. curiosity lights up your face when you talk, and people notice it.
slides.texte_sophia:
a curious mind

i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: a strange animal, a lost city, a painting. curiosity lights up your face when you talk, and people notice it.

slides.texte_overlay:
kindness to strangers

be warm to waiters, drivers and people nobody else notices. the way you treat people who can do nothing for you says more about you than anything else.
